errorCodes.meaning: The network has no entry for the issuer in state `listed` or `acknowledged`.
The network defines no role named `role`.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

RegisteredGroup.description: A group serving a role: the member's signed registration and the network's groupRegistered credential accepting it.

acceptance.description: The network's groupRegistered credential: a statement (`https://openvtc.org/vtn/vsc/groupRegistered/1`) issued by the accepting network, subject the group, `object.digestMultibase` the digest of `registration`, with a `credentialStatus` on the network's revocation list.

endpoint.description: Where the network delivers broadcasts for the group.

group.description: The group: a DID, or for a network group a DID URL on the network's DID (`<did>#role-<name>`).

member.description: The member that registered the group.

registeredAt.description: When the network accepted the registration.

Response.description: The registration as recorded: the member's signed request and the network's groupRegistered credential accepting it.
Response.title: VTN Groups — Register — response payload

RoleName.description: A role's name: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

SignedTask.description: A complete Trust Task document, with its proof, exactly as signed and received. Verified as a document in its own right; open so its proof still covers every member, and so its digest can be recomputed.

schema.description: A member's registration of one of its groups to serve a network role. The signed document is the registration. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

endpoint.description: The HTTPS URL at which the network delivers broadcasts for the group.

group.description: The group: a DID of the member's, or for a network its network group `<networkDid>#role-<localRole>`.

role.description: The network's role the group serves.
